children.html:
What does my day pass include?

Your daily admission pass includes access to: 

  • Locker Room & Steam Rooms
  • Saunas & Base Rock Room
  • Outdoor & Indoor Bade Pools
  • Jacuzzis & Cold Plunge Pool
  • Media Room & Indoor Lounges

Your pass also includes:

  • Spa uniforms (all sizes available. Must be worn during your visit)
  • Complimentary toiletries
  • Towels
  • Shampoo/conditioner/soap

Please Note:

  • Remember to bring your bathing suit if you plan to visit our outdoor or indoor bade pools (you cannot enter these pools without appropriate swimwear).
  • Spa treatments, products, food & beverages are available for an additional fee
  • You cannot leave our facility once you have entered. Please remember to bring all your belongings with you BEFORE entering the spa.
What do I need to bring for my spa day at King Spa Virginia?
  • Valid government issued photo ID (pictures of ID’s and foreign driver’s licenses will not be accepted)
  • Swimsuit (Cotton & denim swimwear are not allowed in the water)
  • (Swimsuits are available for purchase in the Locker Rooms.)
  • Spa lounge uniforms & towels are provided during your stay at King Spa Virginia. 
Do I need a reservation to visit King Spa Virginia?

No, we are on a first come first serve basis at the moment. 

What is the price of admission?

General admission fee is $x per person.  Please note, there are certain weekdays (holiday and peak days) throughout the year that will be considered under the prevailing Weekend/Holiday rate.  For a list of holiday and peak days please view our Holiday Schedule. 

Admission does not include treatments, products, food and beverages.  

Are children allowed at King Spa Virginia?

Children under the age of 12 are not permitted under any circumstances. Minors under 17 years old must be accompanied by an adult 21+ years old and of the same gender. A maximum of 3 children per adult of the same gender are permitted.

(Minors will need a school ID or copy of birth certificate)

Which holidays are considered peak?

The holidays listed below are considered peak visiting times and guests will be charged the “weekend/holiday” rate to enter. Please see current admission pricing here: https://virginia.kingspa.com/day-pass/

  • New Years Eve
  • New Years Day
  • MLK Day
  • Memorial Day (Monday)
  • Labor Day (Monday)
  • Juneteenth
  • Independence Day
  • Christmas Eve
  • Christmas Day
  • Thanksgiving Weekend (Thurs & Fri)
What are your hours?

Sunday – Thursday 9AM to 11PM
Friday & Saturday 9AM to 12 Midnight

Doors will close promptly at closing time, so we kindly ask that you plan to exit the building by then.

Can I get a tour of the facility?

We do not offer tours of the facility. We do have a virtual tour on our website. 

Do you offer group rates or party packages?

We currently do not offer any group discounts or packages. 

Can I visit King Spa Virginia if I am pregnant?

We recommend that you do not visit any spas while you are pregnant.  Our pools and rooms vary in heat from 94-200 degrees and it is not recommended for pregnant women. 

What is the shoe and footwear policy?

King Spa Virginia is a barefoot facility. Sandals and slippers are prohibited as well. You may wear clean socks. 

What is the dress code policy?

King Spa Virginia provides spa lounge wear during your stay.  Outside clothing is prohibited inside the spa facility.  Swimsuits or any articles of clothing are prohibited inside the shower area. 

Swimsuits made of polyester, nylon or spandex are allowed in the Bade Pools and outdoor jacuzzis.  Cotton, denim and other street clothing are not permitted in the pools. 

G-Strings and thongs are also not allowed in the facility. 

Blankets and pillows are not permitted inside the facility. 

What is your policy on alcohol and smoking?

We are a smoke-free, alcohol-free and drug-free facility. Drinking, smoking or using drugs will result in immediate ejection from the facility without a refund.  Drinking prior to entry will also result in ejection without a refund. 

Can I bring my own food or beverages?

No outside food or beverages will be allowed under any circumstances.  We have a full restaurant and drink bar inside the facility for purchase. 

Do you have any promotions or sales?

We currently do not offer any promotions or sales. Please check back periodically or you can enter your email for updates or like us on Facebook & Instagram.
